items.exampleEn: The legislature meets in the large stone building near the park.
items.exampleZh: 立法機關在公園旁那棟大型石造建築裡開會。

items.exampleEn: This wetland is a refuge for thousands of birds in winter.
items.exampleZh: 這片溼地是冬天數千隻鳥的避難所。

items.exampleEn: A legislator visited our school to talk about how laws are made.
items.exampleZh: 一位立法委員來我們學校談法律是怎麼制定的。

items.exampleEn: Lawmakers from both parties agreed on the new budget.
items.exampleZh: 兩黨的立法者都同意了新的預算。

items.exampleEn: The police stopped the offender for driving too fast.
items.exampleZh: 警察因為那名違規者開車太快而把他攔下。

items.exampleEn: The airport keeps the main hall under surveillance day and night.
items.exampleZh: 機場日夜都對大廳進行監視。

items.exampleEn: The accusation against the company turned out to be false.
items.exampleZh: 對那家公司的指控後來證明是假的。

items.exampleEn: The diplomat speaks five languages fluently.
items.exampleZh: 那位外交官能流利地說五種語言。

items.sentenceEn: Surveillance cameras recorded the car leaving the parking lot.
items.sentenceZh: 監視器錄下了那輛車離開停車場的畫面。

items.audioEn: The diplomat will arrive on Tuesday and meet local business leaders on Wednesday.
items.audioZh: 那位外交官星期二抵達，星期三和當地企業領袖會面。
items.questionZh: 外交官星期三要做什麼？

items.sentenceEn: Our town legislature voted to build a new library.
items.sentenceZh: 我們鎮的議會投票通過興建一座新圖書館。

items.sentenceEn: In the heavy rain, the bus shelter was our only refuge.
items.sentenceZh: 大雨中，公車候車亭是我們唯一的避難處。

items.stemEn: Many ____ spent months writing the new traffic law.
items.stemZh: 許多立法者花了好幾個月撰寫這部新的交通法。

items.stemEn: The store put up ____ cameras after several bags went missing.
items.stemZh: 好幾個包包不見之後，那家店裝了監視器。

items.passageEn: Last month, our class visited the city legislature. A legislator showed us the hall where lawmakers discuss new rules for the city. She explained how a new law about park safety was made, from the first idea to the final vote. After the tour, we met a diplomat from Canada who was also visiting the building. He told us that his job is to help people from two countries understand each other. On the bus home, everyone agreed it was our most interesting school trip this year.
items.passageZh: 上個月，我們班參觀了市議會。一位議員帶我們看立法者討論市政新規定的議事廳。她解說一條關於公園安全的新法律是怎麼誕生的，從最初的想法一直到最後的表決。參觀結束後，我們遇到一位也來參觀這棟建築的加拿大外交官。他告訴我們，他的工作是幫助兩個國家的人互相了解。在回家的巴士上，大家都同意這是我們今年最有趣的校外教學。

questions.questionZh: 議員向他們解說了什麼？
options: 議事廳建築的歷史由來

questions.questionZh: 外交官說他的工作是什麼？
options: 幫助兩國的人互相了解

items.promptZh: 她否認了那些指控，說自己整晚都在家。
referenceEn: She denied the accusations and said she was at home all night.
She denied the accusations, saying that she had stayed home all night.
rubricZh: 要用 accusation 的複數（例如 the accusations）
時態合理即可（例如 denied、said）

items.instructionZh: 用 offender 造一個句子，說說在交通或公共場所違反規定的人。
referenceEn: The offender had to pay a fine for parking in a bus lane.
Offenders who smoke in the park may have to pay a fine.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 offender（例如 the offender、offenders）
時態配合內容（例如 had to、may have to 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：裁示「聽選正解不可照抄音檔」：正解改寫成同義說法，干擾項沿用音檔裡的字
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改前：["Meet local business leaders", "Arrive at the airport", "Visit a local school", "Fly back home"]；改後：["See some local company bosses", "Arrive in town", "Meet local school leaders", "Fly back home"]
